description: Address review findings: fix temp file leaks in export endpoints, activate dead-code mask-based crack validation, cap export queries, sync threshold slider on page load, and fix fragile capture ID scanning.
steps: Replace tempfile.mkdtemp() in /api/export/csv and /api/export/excel with in-memory BytesIO buffers to eliminate temp file leaks
Modify inference_core.annotate_frame() to return a 4-tuple including the raw masks numpy array (N,H,W)
Update all callers of annotate_frame (detector.py, capture_manager.py) to handle the 4-tuple
Pass the masks array from annotate_frame through to validate_cracks() in capture_manager._capture_worker()
Cap the export query limit from 100000 to 10000 records in both CSV and Excel endpoints
In dashboard.js, read the threshold from the first /capture/status poll response and sync the slider value
Replace the fragile fname[5:10] substring extraction in _scan_existing_captures() with a regex pattern
acceptance_criteria: Export endpoints use BytesIO (no temp files leaked to disk)
annotate_frame returns (frame, bool, list, masks_or_None) - 4 values
validate_cracks receives actual mask data when available
Export queries are capped at 10000 records
Threshold slider syncs from backend on first poll
Capture ID scan uses regex and handles IDs beyond 99999
All existing integration tests still pass
findings: All 5 review fixes implemented successfully. annotate_frame now returns a 4-tuple (annotated, crack_present, metadata, masks). The masks are passed to validate_cracks enabling circularity, solidity, morphological opening, and edge consistency checks. Export endpoints use BytesIO buffers. A new generate_excel_export_to_buffer() utility was added to report_generator.py. All integration tests pass without modification.
